cognitive_contract.label: Retrieve / instantiate advanced competition theorem (Advanced Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Retrieve and instantiate specialized Olympiad mathematical theorems, invariants, and formulas from deep memory to determine protected value W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to recognize and instantiate the high-level competition theorem without intermediate prompts or formula sheets.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the existence of the specialized competition theorem without providing its symbolic algebraic formulation.

slots.X: retrieval and execution of Brahmagupta's formula for cyclic quadrilaterals
slots.Y: cyclic quadrilateral with consecutive side lengths 2, 3, 4, 7
slots.Z: Brahmagupta's invariant: Area = sqrt((s-a)(s-b)(s-c)(s-d)) where s = (a+b+c+d)/2
slots.wrong_idea: treating quadrilateral as requiring altitude calculations or mistakenly applying triangle Heron's formula
slots.replacement_rule: calculate semi-perimeter s = (2+3+4+7)/2 = 8; evaluate differences (6, 5, 4, 1); compute Area = sqrt(120) = 2*sqrt(30)
slots.visual_job: render cyclic quadrilateral inscribed in circle with sides 2, 3, 4, 7 labeled; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent check: Bretschneider's formula with supplementary opposite angles confirms Area = sqrt(120) = 2*sqrt(30)

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact advanced competition scenario, options with authentic theorem misapplication traps
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 theorem name/domain reminder, H2 semi-perimeter and radical formulation; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; step-by-step why-valid derivation with theorem verification
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student misconception

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative derivation path (e.g. diagonal chord splitting via Law of Cosines instead of direct formula substitution)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item with identical advanced competition theorem retrieval

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item extending theorem to bicentric quadrilaterals or Bretschneider's general case
